questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：We use the past simple tense to talk about actions and situations that happened and finished in the ____.
questions.explanation: 一般过去时（Past Simple）用于表达在过去发生并已经结束的动作或状态。
questions.hint: Think about when the action happened.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Verbs that form their past simple by adding '-ed' are called ____ verbs.
questions.explanation: 规则动词（regular verbs）的过去式通常通过在词尾加 -ed 构成。
questions.hint: They follow the normal rule.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：What is the past simple form of the regular verb 'invite'?
questions.explanation: 以 e 结尾的动词 invite，过去式直接加 d 变成 invited。
questions.hint: Just add -d since it already ends in e.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：What is the past simple form of the regular verb 'study'?
questions.explanation: 以“辅音字母 + y”结尾的动词，变过去式时应把 y 改为 i 再加 -ed，即 studied。
questions.hint: Change y to i before adding -ed.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Verbs like 'write', 'see', and 'go' whose past simple does not end in '-ed' are called ____ verbs.
questions.explanation: 不规则动词（irregular verbs）的过去式不以 -ed 结尾，需要特殊记忆。
questions.hint: They don't follow the standard -ed pattern.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：What is the irregular past simple form of 'write'?
questions.explanation: 动词 write 的过去式是不规则的 wrote（written 是过去分词）。
questions.hint: It changes its vowel sound.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：What is the irregular past simple form of 'go'?
questions.explanation: 动词 go 的过去式是 went。
questions.hint: A completely different word is used.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：What is the past simple form of 'shut'?
questions.explanation: 动词 shut 的过去式和原形相同，仍然是 shut。
questions.hint: Some verbs don't change at all in the past tense.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Which of the following is correct for the past simple of 'stop'?
questions.explanation: stop 是重读闭音节结尾，双写最后一个辅音字母 p 再加 -ed，即 stopped。
questions.hint: Double the final consonant before -ed.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：Mozart ____ more than 600 pieces of music.
questions.explanation: 句中描述历史上莫扎特创作音乐的过去动作，应用一般过去时不规则动词 wrote。
questions.hint: Use the past form of write.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：In questions and negative sentences in the past simple, we use ____ + infinitive.
questions.explanation: 在一般过去时的疑问句和否定句中，我们需要借助助动词 did / didn't，后接动词原形。
questions.hint: The past auxiliary verb is used here.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：I didn't ____ anything because I didn't have any money.
questions.explanation: 在 didn't 后面必须使用动词原形 buy。
questions.hint: Didn't is followed by the base form of the verb.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：'Did you go out?' 'No, I ____.'
questions.explanation: 问句以 Did 开头，简短否定回答用 No, I didn't。
questions.hint: Match the auxiliary verb from the question.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：What ____ you do at the weekend?
questions.explanation: 询问过去周末做了什么，应用过去时助动词 did。
questions.hint: The main verb is 'do', and the question is in the past tense.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：What is the past simple form of the verb 'be' for the pronouns 'I / he / she / it'?
questions.explanation: 动词 be 在一般过去时中，第一人称单数和第三人称单数（I/he/she/it）对应的形式是 was。
questions.hint: Singular subject takes 'was'.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：What is the past simple form of the verb 'be' for 'we / you / they'?
questions.explanation: 动词 be 在一般过去时中，复数主语和第二人称（we/you/they）对应的形式是 were。
questions.hint: Plural subject takes 'were'.

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Choose the correct sentence with the verb 'be'.
options: I was hungry, so I didn't eat anything.
I were hungry, so I didn't eat anything.
I did hungry, so I didn't eat anything.
I am hungry, so I didn't eat anything.
questions.explanation: 主语是 I，be 动词的过去式应用 was；而后面的 didn't eat 描述动作，前后时态一致。
questions.hint: I takes 'was' in the past simple.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：____ the weather good when you were on holiday?
questions.explanation: 主语 the weather 是单数不可数名词，相当于 it，故疑问句中 be 动词用 Was。
questions.hint: The weather is singular (it).

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Why do we say 'She wasn't able to come' instead of 'She didn't be able to come'?
options: Because 'be' in the past simple has its own forms (was/were) and does not use 'did' as an auxiliary for simple states.
Because 'did' can never be used with 'be'.
questions.explanation: be 动词在一般过去时中自身有 was/were 形式，其否定和疑问直接在 be 后加 not 或提前，不与 did 连用。
questions.hint: The verb 'be' doesn't need 'did' for questions and negatives.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：They weren't able to come because they ____ so busy.
questions.explanation: 主语是复数 they，故 be 动词的过去式应用 were。
questions.hint: Match the plural subject 'they'.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：Dave ____ down the stairs this morning and hurt his leg.
questions.explanation: 句子描述今天早上的过去动作，fall 的过去式是不规则的 fell。
questions.hint: Use the past form of fall.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：'How did you learn to drive?' 'My father ____ me.'
questions.explanation: teach 的过去式是不规则动词 taught。
questions.hint: The past form of teach rhymes with caught.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：We couldn't afford to keep our car, so we ____ it.
questions.explanation: sell 的过去式是不规则动词 sold。
questions.hint: The past form of sell is sold.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：It was warm, so I ____ off my coat.
questions.explanation: take 的过去式是不规则动词 took。
questions.hint: The past form of take.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：I knew Sarah was busy, so I ____ her.
questions.explanation: 根据上下文“我知道萨拉很忙，所以我没有打扰她”或者肯定含义，这里使用动词 disturb 的过去式 disturbed（或根据练习5.4第3题原句：I knew Sarah was busy, so I didn't disturb her. 哎呀，注意5.4第3题原句是否定形式：so I didn't disturb her. 让我们核对选项）。选项中若有 didn't disturb 则选它。
questions.hint: Check if it requires a positive or negative past form based on meaning.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：I knew Sarah was busy, so I ____ her. (用括号内动词的正确形式填空)
questions.explanation: 根据教材原句练习 5.4 第 3 题：I knew Sarah was busy, so I didn't disturb her. 表示因为知道她忙，所以“没有”打扰她。
questions.hint: Since she was busy, you didn't do it.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：The window was open and a bird ____ into the room.
questions.explanation: fly 的过去式是不规则动词 flew。
questions.hint: The past form of fly.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：I was in a hurry, so I ____ time to call you.
questions.explanation: 因为在赶时间，所以“没有”时间给你打电话，应用否定形式 didn't have。
questions.hint: Because of being in a hurry, you lacked time.

questions.prompt: 完成句子：The bed was very uncomfortable. I ____ well.
questions.explanation: 床很不舒服，所以推导出“我没有睡好”，应用否定式 didn't sleep。
questions.hint: An uncomfortable bed means poor sleep quality (negative).

questions.prompt: 选出填空最恰当的一项：Which of the following questions is correctly formed in the past simple?
questions.explanation: 一般过去时特殊疑问句结构为：特殊疑问词 + did + 主语 + 动词原形？故 Where did you go? 是正确的。
questions.hint: Remember: Question word + did + subject + base verb.
